NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING
  AND
  AGENDA

  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  SPECIAL MEETING
  HAWAIIAN GARDENS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  MONDAY, MARCH 16, 2020 AT 6:15 P.M.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that I, LUCIE COLOMBO, CMC, City Clerk of the City of
Hawaiian Gardens hereby give notice and certify that Mayor Jesse Alvarado has called a
SPECIAL MEETING of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens to be held on
MONDAY, MARCH 16, 2020 commencing at 6:15 PM, at the City of Hawaiian Gardens, City
Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, CA 90716.

THIS SPECIAL MEETING IS HEREBY CALLED AND NOTICED PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA
GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.

PLEASE NOTE THAT PURSUANT TO THE GOVERNOR OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA’S
EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, AND IN THE INTEREST OF THE PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY,
MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND OR STAFF MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA
TELECONFERENCE.

PLEASE FURTHER NOTE THAT CONSISTENT WITH THE GOVERNOR’S ORDER, MEMBERS OF
THE PUBLIC PRESENT AT THE MEETING MUST FOLLOW ADEQUATE AND NECESSARY
PROCEDURES TO PROVIDE AND MAINTAIN LOCAL HEALTH AND SAFETY OF ALL PERSONS,
INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION BY ALLOWING FOR A DISTANCE OF SIX (6) FEET PER
PERSON.

IN A FURTHER EFFORT TO ALLOW FOR SOCIAL DISTANCING, PERSONS THAT DO NOT WISH
TO APPEAR IN PERSON AT THE MEETING MAY SUBMIT PUBLIC COMMENT IN ADVANCE OF
THE MEETING BY EMAILING THE CITY CLERK AT LCOLOMBO@HGCITY.ORG. A STAFF
MEMBER WILL READ THESE PUBLIC COMMENT SUBMISSIONS INTO THE RECORD DURING
THE “PUBLIC COMMENTS” PORTION OF THE AGENDA, PROVIDED THAT SUCH COMMENTS
(A) ARE SUBMITTED AND RECEIVED NO LATER THAN 3:30 P.M. ON MARCH 16, 2020; (B) ARE
NO LONGER THAN 250 WORDS; AND (C) IN ACCORDANCE WITH GOVERNMENT CODE
SECTION 54954.3(A), RELATE ONLY TO ITEMS LISTED ON THE AGENDA. PUBLIC COMMENT
SUBMISSIONS NOT MEETING EACH OF THESE CRITERIA WILL NOT BE READ INTO THE
RECORD.

CALL TO ORDER

INVOCATION

FLAG SALUTE

CITY COUNCIL NOTICE AND AGENDA
EMERGENCY MEETING
MARCH 16, 2020
 ROLL CALL
  MAYOR  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR PRO TEM  LUIS ROA
  COUNCILMEMBER  VICTOR FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER  MYRA MARAVILLA
  COUNCILMEMBER  HANK TRIMBLE

PUBLIC COMMENTS - ITEMS ONLY ON THE AGENDA

During the Special Meeting, the Council shall provide members of the public the opportunity to address
the City Council to speak on items on the agenda only, in accordance with Government Code Section
54954.3(a). Each speaker shall be limited to three (3) minutes of public comment. The City Council
shall not discuss or take action relative to any public comment unless authorized by California
Government Code Section 54954.2(b).

A.  DISCUSSION
1.  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN
  GARDENS DECLARING THE EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY

  CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION TO DECLARE A LOCAL
  EMERGENCY IN THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS DUE TO THE
  POTENTIAL HEALTH, SAFETY, AND SECURITY RELATING TO COVID-
  19 – NOVEL CORONAVIRUS AND AUTHORIZING THE USE OF CITY
  RESERVE FUNDING

  COUNCIL ACTION: City Council to adopt Resolution Declaring Local
  Emergency, and Provide Further Direction to Staff Relating Thereto.

2.  DISCUSSION  REGARDING  CITY  RESPONSE  TO  NOVEL
  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) AND USE OF CITY RESERVE FUNDING
  DURING EXISTENCE OF LOCAL EMERGENCY

  CONSIDERATION OF ACTION REGARDING CITY’S RESPONSE,
  INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, AUTHORIZATIONS AND
  MEASURES TO PROMOTE SOCIAL DISTANCING, AS WELL AS USE
  OF CITY RESERVE FUNDING DURING EXISTENCE OF LOCAL
  EMERGENCY

  COUNCIL ACTION: City Council to Provide Direction to Staff

C.  ADJOURNMENT
  Adjourn to a Regular City Council meeting to be held on Tuesday, March 24, 2020 at
  6:00 p.m.

  THIS NOTICE IS HEREBY SIGNED AND DATED ON MARCH 15, 2020.

  _______________________________
  LUCIE COLOMBO, CMC, CPMC
  CITY CLERK
CITY COUNCIL NOTICE AND AGENDA
EMERGENCY MEETING
MARCH 16, 2020

MINUTES  10-27-2020

  MONDAY, MARCH 16, 2020 AT 6:15 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER
The Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to order by
Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Monday, March 16, 2020, at 6:17 PM in the City Council Chambers,
21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

INVOCATION
Lucie Colombo, City Clerk led the invocation.
FLAG SALUTE

 Mayor Pro Tem Roa led the flag salute.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  MAYOR  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR PRO TEM  LUIS ROA
  COUNCILMEMBER  VICTOR FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER  MYRA MARAVILLA
ABSENT
  COUNCILMEMBER  HANK TRIMBLE

Lucie Colombo, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - ITEMS ONLY ON THE AGENDA

Francis Rodriguez submitted a comment.

Selena Para submitted a comment.

A.  DISCUSSION
 1.  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN
  GARDENS DECLARING THE EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY

  COUNCIL ACTION: City Council to adopt Resolution Declaring Local
  Emergency and Provide Further Direction to Staff Relating Thereto.

  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
EMERGENCY MEETING
MARCH 16, 2020
   DISCUSSION (CONTINUED).

  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, spoke.

  Steven J. Gomez, Director of Recreation & Community Services, spoke.

  Mayor Alvarado spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

  Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

  It was moved by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember
  Maravilla and approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt Resolution
  Declaring Local Emergency.

  AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, ALVARADO, ROA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  TRIMBLE
  Motion carried, 4-0. Councilmember Trimble was absent.

 2.  DISCUSSION  REGARDING  CITY  RESPONSE  TO  NOVEL
  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) AND USE OF CITY RESERVE FUNDING
  DURING EXISTENCE OF LOCAL EMERGENCY

  COUNCIL ACTION: City Council to Provide Direction to Staff

  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Mayor Alvarado spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

  Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

  It was moved by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa
  and approved by roll call vote as follows to direct the staff to return with
  budget amendment reflecting the changes as proposed by the
  councilmember, in addition authorize the city to use the reserves for one (1)
  month.

  AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, ALVARADO, ROA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  TRIMBLE

  Motion carried, 4-0. Councilmember Trimble was absent.

MARCH 16, 2020
